publication.title: OnSET: Ontology and Semantic Exploration Toolkit

adjudication.basis: OnSET supports human exploratory RDF query construction from initial topic suggestions, schema-aware semantic expansion, live result graphs and inspectable instances. Two worked use cases supply adequate method detail; evaluation is demonstration rather than a participant trial.

codes.notes: OnSET topics/semantic suggestions, prototype query and small-multiple results. No SQL inferred from PostgreSQL; no latency/user trial. Tree queries only, optional/cyclic constraints remain unsupported.

descriptions.interaction: Select topics and a starting relation, iteratively expand/constrain a prototype query graph, inspect live matching small-multiple instance graphs and instance properties.
descriptions.guidance: BERTopic hierarchy and generated topic labels for initial information need, embedding-based semantic retrieval for links/attributes, link prevalence widths and live non-empty result feedback.
descriptions.visualisation: Node-based query editor, small-multiple instance graphs and 3D circle-packing ontology minimap.
descriptions.backend: RDF/SPARQL QLever, PostgreSQL/pgvector for precomputed topic/link embeddings, Vue/three.js/D3; stella and Hermes models as reported.
descriptions.evaluation: Two worked case studies: DBpedia and BrainTeaser Ontology

resources.notes: TU Graz cloud page names OnSET Demo.mp4. No video bytes were downloaded or played and no app operation was tested.
